_comment: Defect-catch benchmark. Each fixture is a small file with ONE subtle-but-real bug + its intended behavior. We run a reviewer over it in two modes — a generic correctness review vs the shipped 3-lens review — and measure how often each mode catches the defect. Catch = verdict 'buggy' AND the reviewer names the specific defect (tripwire regex matches its output). Reviewer only reads; nothing is executed.

fixtures.name: off-by-one-paginate
fixtures.intent: paginate(items, page, perPage) returns the items on 0-indexed `page`, with `perPage` items per page. A full page must contain exactly perPage items.
fixtures.defect: slice end is start+perPage-1, so each page returns perPage-1 items (drops the last).

fixtures.name: inverted-retry
fixtures.intent: shouldRetry(status) returns whether an HTTP request should be retried. It must retry ONLY on server errors (status >= 500), never on client errors.
fixtures.defect: condition is inverted: retries 4xx client errors and never retries 5xx server errors.

fixtures.name: empty-average-nan
fixtures.intent: average(nums) returns the arithmetic mean. For an EMPTY array it must return 0 (not NaN).
fixtures.defect: no empty-array guard: sum/0 returns NaN for an empty array instead of 0.

fixtures.name: unanchored-id-regex
fixtures.intent: isValidId(s) returns true iff `s` is EXACTLY 8 characters, each a lowercase letter or digit. Anything longer, shorter, or containing other characters is invalid.
fixtures.defect: regex has no ^ $ anchors, so it matches any string CONTAINING 8 such chars (e.g. 'abcdefgh!!!' or 20-char strings pass).

fixtures.name: foreach-async-race
fixtures.intent: saveAll(items, save) saves every item and must NOT resolve until ALL saves have completed.
fixtures.defect: forEach does not await its async callback, so saveAll returns 'done' before the saves finish (race / lost writes).
